description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hendiyagala, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420513
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (Parcel Nos. 81 and 32) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, ownership details, and title classification. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
